newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Optical Coating EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Optical Coating EPS cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it reduced its FY97 EPS estimate on Optical Coating Laboratory Inc by $0.05 to $0.90 from $0.95.

--It acted after the company disclosed Monday that Optical Corp of America's board decided not to proceed with a planned merger with Optical Coating, previously scheduled for completion at the end of September.
--EVEREN had previously increased its FY96 EPS estimate by $0.05 on Optical Coating, believing the merger would be additive to earnings.
--Analyst Timothy Gerdeman in a report reiterated his long-term outperformer ratings on Optical Coating and long-term price target of $20.
